budget_items.topic: FY19 total collections and revenue vs. estimates
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total FY19 collections and the amount by which actuals exceeded estimates.
budget_items.quote: total collections for fy19 are $40,740,654.14. actuals exceeded estimates by .22% or $88,772.34.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Taxes came in below the levy estimate, and tax lien revenue was received.
budget_items.quote: we received 98.35% or $441,858.79 less than the levy estimate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State aid came in above the estimate, mainly from charter tuition reimbursement and FY18 Chapter 40S funds received early in FY19.
budget_items.quote: we received 100.82% or $72,416.00 more than the state aid

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expended or encumbered amount as a share of budget, appropriation closeouts, and State Assessments above cherry sheet estimates.

Read-out of unexpended or unappropriated balances at year-end across Salary Reserve, Public Buildings, Facilities & Grounds, Police, Police Lock Up, Building Inspection, School Department, Highway Labor, Vehicle Maintenance, Veterans Benefits, and Workers Comp/Liability.
budget_items.quote: salary reserve- there was an unappropriated balance of $57,303.04 in this account at year-end.

budget_items.topic: Unemployment Compensation closeout to free cash
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unemployment Compensation balance will close to free cash at year-end because benefits were limited.
budget_items.quote: in fy 19 and as a result, $5,719.00 will close to free cash

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Free cash expected to be roughly the printed amount once reports are complete, and somewhere around $1 million per Brochu.
budget_items.quote: is roughly si million. once all the reports are complete

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Motor vehicle excise estimate raised to allow the budgeted contribution to the pavement management plan.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital Plan historically had about the printed amount in a good year, with requests always above $1 million.
budget_items.quote: the capital plan was lucky if it had $400,000 in a good year.
